title: Bilinear rough singular integrals under a fractional geometric condition
summary: We establish the Banach-range boundedness of bilinear rough singular integral operators, together with their maximal and maximally truncated forms, under the fractional geometric condition on the mean-zero angular kernel \[ \sup_{ξ\in \mathbb{S}^{1}}\int_{\mathbb{S}^{1}} \frac{|Ω(θ)|}{|θ\cdot ξ|^{a}} \, dσ(θ) 1)$ constraints considered by Grafakos, He, Honzík (Adv. Math., 2018), Dosidis and Slavíková (Math. Ann., 2024), while defining a class of functions that is neither contained in nor contains the classical Orlicz space $L(\log L)^α(\mathbb{S}^1) $ ($α>1$).
